title: Filtered protected Preview passed local validation
summary: 1,208-file package builds 226 pages; TypeScript, 62 security tests, 37 acceptance checks, 30 images and 50 API/guard checks passed. No upload or deployment.

changes.detail: Full local course generation/validation and a 177-file SHA-256 certificate; required webpack loader and pure environment policy included in package.
Preview-only configuration uses lifecycle-disabled clean install, verified course content, isolated file tracing and no webpack disk cache.
Preview-only terminal route returns 403 without importing native terminal tooling or initializing timers.
Native HTTPS adapter has exact host/path allowlist, timeout, sanitized results and no retry/redirect behavior; submission requires protected staging and rejects unexpected target/URL/identity.
Only disposable npm and webpack caches created during this run were removed for disk recovery. No source or recovery evidence removed; NTFS compression preserved file bytes.

validation.name: Course correctness
validation.detail: 48 modules, 192 lessons, 3 languages, 635429 checks. Generated output matches source after CRLF/LF normalization; 177 original byte hashes pinned.

validation.name: Filtered clean install/build/types
validation.detail: npm ci installed 604 packages with scripts disabled; corrected native probe passed; filtered Next.js build generated 226 pages and explicit TypeScript passed.

validation.name: Security and runtime
validation.detail: 62 focused tests on filtered source; 37 runtime/browser checks; all 30 image HTTP/hash checks. 288 output traces contain no outside/missing files and no node-pty references.

validation.name: Regression and transport
validation.detail: 120 candidate regressions, 50 API/guard tests and 4 unmodified CLI loopback scenarios passed.

validation.name: Provider and preservation
validation.detail: GET-only audit verified staging identity, protection=all, no exceptions/Git/crons, Preview-only sensitive variable scopes and disabled flags. 2601 baseline hashes match; 137 tracked changes and 15 untracked files preserved.

validation.name: Limits
validation.detail: No Linux hosted build, live datastore storefront acceptance, upload or deployment. Consumed hosted verifier not rerun. Existing lint warnings remain. Pattern scans are not an exhaustive secret proof.
